meta.title: DeepSeek Harness app controls
meta.description: Adds check/update and quit buttons to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, plus a KDE system-tray controller and a settings panel in Plugins. Settings cover the tray icon (DeepSeek, classic or custom), per-feature show/hide controls, update policy, and a remembered default startup window size; they are stored locally and applied on the next DSH start. The buttons check/update DSH with running-task warnings, deferral, release notes and a minimizable progress dialog, or gracefully stop the service and close the window; a single-instance tray shows status and offers open, same-window plugins/settings navigation, update, restart, stop, logs and copy URL. Applicable to DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.x Web profile on Linux/KDE (Chrome app window) and Node.js 20+; the tray needs PyQt5. It also offers optional cache cleanup (application, npx/npm/pnpm, update leftovers) that never removes the running DSH, plugin source, installed plugins, settings, sessions or sign-in state. The tray menu follows the DSH light/dark theme; background update checks run every 30 minutes, notify only when an update exists, and show a toast in the app; updates can be deferred for a configurable period.
